items.source: TestContextEvent published by the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener when TestExecutionListener.prepareTestInstance(TestContext) is invoked.
items.translation: 由 EventPublishingTestExecutionListener 发布的 TestContextEvent，当调用 TestExecutionListener.prepareTestInstance(TestContext) 时。

items.source: @RecordApplicationEvents is an annotation that can be applied to a test class to instruct the Spring TestContext Framework to record all application events that are published in the ApplicationContext during the execution of a single test, either from the test thread or its descendants.
items.translation: @RecordApplicationEvents 是一个注解，可应用于测试类，以指示 Spring TestContext Framework 记录在单个测试执行期间发布的 application events，这些事件发布在 ApplicationContext 中，无论是由测试线程还是其子线程发布。

items.source: TestExecutionListener which provides support for ApplicationEvents.
items.translation: TestExecutionListener 提供对 ApplicationEvents 的支持。

items.source: ApplicationEvents encapsulates all application events that were fired during the execution of a single test method.
items.translation: ApplicationEvents 封装了在单个测试方法执行期间触发过的所有application events。

items.source: Holder class to expose the application events published during the execution of a test in the form of a thread-bound ApplicationEvents object.
items.translation: 用于在测试执行期间以线程绑定的 `ApplicationEvents` 对象形式公开已发布的应用程序事件的 Holder 类。

items.source: Base class for events published by the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener.
items.translation: 由EventPublishingTestExecutionListener发布的事件的基类。

items.source: TestContextEvent published by the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener when TestExecutionListener.afterTestClass(TestContext) is invoked.
items.translation: 由 EventPublishingTestExecutionListener 发布的 TestContextEvent，当调用 TestExecutionListener.afterTestClass(TestContext) 时。

items.source: TestContextEvent published by the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener when TestExecutionListener.afterTestExecution(TestContext) is invoked.
items.translation: 由 EventPublishingTestExecutionListener 发布的 TestContextEvent，当调用 TestExecutionListener.afterTestExecution(TestContext) 时。

items.source: TestContextEvent published by the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener when TestExecutionListener.afterTestMethod(TestContext) is invoked.
items.translation: 由 EventPublishingTestExecutionListener 发布的 TestContextEvent，当调用 TestExecutionListener.afterTestMethod(TestContext) 时。

items.source: TestContextEvent published by the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener when TestExecutionListener.beforeTestClass(TestContext) is invoked.
items.translation: 由 EventPublishingTestExecutionListener 发布的 TestContextEvent，当调用 TestExecutionListener.beforeTestClass(TestContext) 时。

items.source: TestContextEvent published by the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener when TestExecutionListener.beforeTestExecution(TestContext) is invoked.
items.translation: 由 EventPublishingTestExecutionListener 发布的 TestContextEvent，当调用 TestExecutionListener.beforeTestExecution(TestContext) 时。

items.source: TestContextEvent published by the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener when TestExecutionListener.beforeTestMethod(TestContext) is invoked.
items.translation: 由 EventPublishingTestExecutionListener 发布的 TestContextEvent，当调用 TestExecutionListener.beforeTestMethod(TestContext) 时。

items.source: TestExecutionListener that publishes test execution events to the ApplicationContext for the currently executing test.
items.translation: 发布测试执行事件到当前正在执行的测试的 ApplicationContext 的 TestExecutionListener。

items.source: Test event support classes for the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: 测试事件支持类，用于Spring 测试上下文框架。

items.source: This package contains the Spring TestContext Framework which provides annotation-driven unit and integration testing support that is agnostic of the actual testing framework in use.
items.translation: 该包包含Spring TestContext 框架，它提供与所使用的实际测试框架无关的基于注解的单元测试和集成测试支持。

items.source: Test execution event annotations for the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: Spring TestContext Framework 的测试执行事件注解。
